title: Exports are sorted-key JSON
problem_statement: Reviewers diff exports between versions, so the same records must always produce the same bytes. Consumers are written in Python and Rust and must parse an export without a third-party library in Python.
decision: `smp export` writes JSON with object keys sorted and two-space indentation.
rationale: Python's standard library parses JSON, and sorted keys make the output depend only on the records.
positive: A diff between two exports shows only the records that changed.
negative: JSON has no comments, so an export cannot carry reviewer notes.

alternatives.name: YAML
alternatives.description: Write the records as a YAML sequence.
cons: Python's standard library has no YAML parser.
alternatives.why_rejected: Python consumers would need a third-party library.

alternatives.name: TOML
alternatives.description: Write the records as an array of TOML tables.
pros: Python 3.11 and later parse it with the standard library.
cons: Python's standard library cannot write TOML.
alternatives.why_rejected: Python tooling that rewrites an export would need a third-party library.
